subject: CS477
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, one for each of the 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The selected videos are highly relevant, from reputable channels with high view counts, and directly address the core concepts students struggle with. For English, selections from Prof. Ravindrababu Ravula and Gate Smashers dominate due to their exceptional clarity and reach. For Arabic, selections from مبادرة زاد, كاظم المشرفاوي, and منتظر القصير provide strong coverage.

videos.title: CD | Parsers | Examples on how to find first and follow in LL(1) | Ravindrababu Ravula |Free GATE CS
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly-viewed, comprehensive lecture that covers calculating both FIRST and FOLLOW sets with clear examples, making it ideal for students.

videos.title: Lec-13: CLR Parsing Table | LR(1) Canonical Items
videos.filter_reason: With over a million views, this Gate Smashers video provides a concise and focused explanation of constructing LR(1) canonical items and the CLR parsing table.

videos.title: Lec-12: SLR(1) Parsing Table | Check Whether a Grammar is SLR(1) or Not | Bottom-Up Parser
videos.filter_reason: This video is the most popular on the topic, offering a very clear and concise explanation of how to construct an SLR(1) parsing table and check the grammar.

videos.title: CD | Introduction | Elimination of Left Recursion and Left Factoring the Grammars | RBR
videos.filter_reason: This highly-regarded video directly addresses the main student struggle by focusing on the essential prerequisites of eliminating left recursion and left factoring.

videos.title: CD | Introduction | Ambiguous Grammars and Making Them Unambiguous | Ravindrababu Ravula | Free GATE
videos.filter_reason: This popular and in-depth lecture covers both identifying ambiguous grammars and, crucially, the methods for converting them to unambiguous ones.

videos.title: 06 - مترجمات شرح  First and Follow & Parsing table
videos.filter_reason: This is the most-viewed Arabic video on the topic, providing a comprehensive explanation of both FIRST and FOLLOW sets and their use in parsing tables.

videos.title: Compiler Design (المترجمات) |  LR (1)

videos.filter_reason: With the highest view count among Arabic candidates, this video provides a clear and comprehensive explanation of SLR and LR(0) item construction.

videos.title: Compiler Design (المترجمات) | Eliminate Left Recursion & Left Factoring
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly targeted at the core difficulty of this topic, focusing specifically on how to eliminate left recursion and left factoring in Arabic.
